tooltip.dragonmaid.wing_guard_legend: Lightning dragons can open with a wing-assisted thrust using ordinary melee weapons. Leaving combat or using breath refreshes the move.

tooltip.dragonmaid.wing_guard_legend.3: With a longsword, the dragon can advance under ranged fire, blocking projectiles and sometimes sending them back.

config.dragonmaid.meleeKnockbackCap.tool: Caps miniature wing/tail melee knockback, independently of breath and lightning knockback. Reopen the world.
